title: Virtual screening, identification, and potential antioxidant mechanism of novel bioactive peptides during aging by a short-chain peptidomics, quantitative structure-activity relationship analysis, and molecular docking.
one_liner_zh: 该文用短肽组学、QSAR和分子对接筛选白酒抗氧化肽并预测其与Keap1蛋白的互作，虽涉及分子对接但对象为蛋白-肽而非蛋白-DNA，且无TF-DNA结合建模，仅方法部分可借鉴。
abstract: Antioxidant peptides have received a great deal of attention. However, only a few studies have been conducted on the antioxidant peptides originating from Baijiu. A total of 1490 features deemed potential short-chain peptides (the amino acid number between 2 and 4, SCPs) were screened and analyzed by a customized short-chain peptidomics approach in Feng-flavor Baijiu (FFB) during 14 years of aging, with an obvious discrepancy between FFB aged for 3 years and 6 years being observed. Thirty-nine characteristic SCPs in total were identified and accurately quantified by high-throughput parallel reaction monitoring-based synthetic standards, with the contents ranging from 0.16 to 279.33 mug L(-1). Combined with the absorption, distribution, metabolism, excretion, and toxicity analysis model, PGRW, WK, SC, and PAW, four novel antioxidant peptides with high ABTS radical scavenging capacity, were obtained using a customized quantitative structure-activity relationship (QSAR) model based on a two terminal position numbering method, with satisfied coefficients of determination (R(2)), internal cross-validated R(2) (Q(2)), and external R(2) (R(2)pre) of 0.925, 0.808, and 0.665, respectively. Furthermore, these 4 antioxidant peptides could block the Keap-Nrf2 interaction and promote the accumulation of Nrf2 by molecular docking analysis, and the interaction energy between peptide PGRW and Keap1 was higher than that between epigallocatechin gallate and Keap1 based on CHARMm forced field. Overall, this study facilitated the discovery of functional peptides in Baijiu and the understanding of aging mechanisms.
abstract_zh: 抗氧化肽已受到广泛关注。然而，关于源自白酒的抗氧化肽研究却相对较少。通过定制化的短链肽组学方法，在14年陈酿期间的凤香型白酒（FFB）中筛选并分析了1490个被视为潜在短链肽（氨基酸数量介于2至4之间，SCPs）的特征，观察到陈酿3年与6年的FFB之间存在显著差异。共鉴定出39个特征性SCPs，并通过基于高通量平行反应监测的合成标准品进行准确定量，其含量范围为0.16至279.33微克每升。结合吸收、分布、代谢、排泄和毒性分析模型，利用基于双末端位置编号法的定制定量构效关系（QSAR）模型，获得了四种具有高ABTS自由基清除能力的新型抗氧化肽PGRW、WK、SC和PAW，其决定系数（R²）、内部交叉验证R²（Q²）和外部R²（R²pre）分别为0.925、0.808和0.665，均表现良好。此外，通过分子对接分析，这四种抗氧化肽能够阻断Keap-Nrf2相互作用并促进Nrf2的积累，且基于CHARMm力场，肽PGRW与Keap1之间的相互作用能高于表没食子儿茶素没食子酸酯与Keap1之间的相互作用能。总体而言，本研究促进了白酒中功能性肽的发现及对陈酿机制的理解。
